usage: ferb [-h] [--version]
            {logs,trace,verdict,daemon,memory,runtimes,restore,browsers,ps,mcp,setup,doctor,stats,uninstall}
            ...

positional arguments:
  {logs,trace,verdict,daemon,memory,runtimes,restore,browsers,ps,mcp,setup,doctor,stats,uninstall}
    logs                live stream from the daemon's bus
    trace               what a task did, step by step (default: the latest
                        task)
    verdict             record your pass/fail verdict on a task (acceptance is
                        your word)
    daemon              run the daemon
    memory              what FERB remembers: list, show, profile, add, edit,
                        retract, forget
    runtimes            model runtimes: the runtime table, what each role
                        uses; `use` switches a role
    restore             files FERB changed or moved to the Trash lately;
                        restore <id> puts one back
    browsers            browser profiles, pairing and connection status
    ps                  background processes FERB started
    mcp                 (used by runtimes) the stdio MCP shim; needs
                        FERB_RUN_TOKEN
    setup               a checkout: install FERB's interpreter, venv and
                        development LaunchAgent; FERB.app: its setup steps
    doctor              check the installation, permissions (from inside the
                        daemon) and self-test
    stats               how FERB is doing: task outcomes, tool errors, model
                        runs, and its own CPU and memory per day (from the
                        database)
    uninstall           stop the background service and remove its files;
                        --purge also deletes ~/.ferb and every FERB Keychain
                        item

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

    unpair              forget a profile's pairing

                   ...

positional arguments:
  {list,show,add,profile,retract,edit,forget,dashboard,eval-export,embeddings,digest,search,rollback}
    list                active items (--proposed: observed patterns still
                        gathering days; --all: everything)
    show                every item about a subject, with its history and
                        sources
    add                 remember something you state
    profile             the core profile (Tier 1): what is always in FERB's
                        prompts
    retract             stop using an item (kept as history)
    edit                correct an item (a new version; the old one stays as
                        history)
    forget              delete an item, its versions and the activity rows it
                        came from (asks first)
    dashboard           open the token-protected local memory dashboard link
    eval-export         export actual owner-history queries for relevance
                        labels
    embeddings          the local embedding model: loaded or not, where, and
                        how many vectors
    digest              pending identity suggestions, at most once a day
    search              find episodes, facts and activity summaries
    rollback            invalidate a sleep-learning batch while preserving
                        history

setup:
usage: ferb setup [-h] [--update] [--codex-login] [--codex-logout] [--cli]
                  [--claude-logout] [--cleanup] [--ok DIGEST] [--service]
                  [--app-service]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --update         only reinstall FERB into a new venv and restart the daemon
  --codex-login    sign in FERB's own Codex (its own home: your personal Codex
                   settings and skills stay out)
  --codex-logout   sign out FERB's own Codex (your personal Codex login is
                   never touched)
  --cli            link the `ferb` command at ~/.local/bin to this FERB.app
                   (Settings → Advanced)
  --claude-logout  sign out FERB's own Claude (your personal Claude Code login
                   is never touched)
  --cleanup        FERB.app's clean-up screen: what the one-time clean-up of
                   unused data removes, as JSON; with --ok, run it (the daemon
                   is stopped meanwhile)
  --ok DIGEST      with --cleanup: the `ok` of the preview the owner agreed to
  --service        FERB.app's setup window: install (with --update, update)
                   the background service with no questions and wait until it
                   answers
  --app-service    with --service: FERB.app registers the service itself (a
                   Developer ID build): retire any LaunchAgent and load
                   nothing
